name: You Rock Summer Camp
description_short: A week-long rock band camp at You Rock School of Music in Cranston, RI, for kids of all experience levels. Campers form bands, name them, write original songs, rehearse and perform live at a Friday show, with tie-dye, games and jam sessions along the way. 2026 camp was 6 hours a day at $489 per week.
